name: Albert Keats
source:
“Did you know? There are times when you simply do not have to endure.”

The young butler of the Cavendish family. For generations, the Keats family has served as stewards and butlers to the Earl’s household. He is currently taking over his uncle’s duties while the uncle is bedridden. It seems he knows some major secret about the Cavendish family.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
